email.subject: Tidewater Works: a couple of quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Grace,

I checked Tidewater Works' site. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no click-to-call number, so mobile visitors can't tap to dial, and there's no mobile-friendly layout, so most people checking you out on their phone (probably the majority of HVAC searches) have a hard time even reading your page. On top of that, there's no way to book a job online, so anyone searching after hours just moves on.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you what I found?

Alex
Northlight Web
